task.description:
Hard gate: validate the design artefact at src/design/iss-0068-onboarding-schema-provisioning.md before BACKEND-DEV starts implementing.

Check:
1. Every acceptance criterion from ISS-0068 has a matching design element.
2. No implementation code is present in the design (prose + interfaces only).
3. All public function signatures are listed with types and error sets.
4. The retroactive migration SQL is present and is explicitly idempotent.
5. Error taxonomy covers all new failure modes introduced by the fix.
6. Both invariants (schema created on success, schema removed on compensation) are explicitly stated.
7. The design is sufficient for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity.
